title: Progression/unlocks: Cordite or platform concern?
description: Are XP, ranks, unlock trees, battle passes, and seasonal content part of the game mode definition, or a platform concern above Cordite? Arguments for Cordite: unlock trees affect available weapons/equipment, which Cordite already defines. Arguments against: progression is account-level state, not match-level state; it's a monetization/retention layer, not a rules layer. Probably out of scope — Cordite defines what's available, the platform decides who has unlocked it.
